about.title: About
about.subtitle: A bit about who I am and what I do.
about.p1: In 2021 I moved from Barcelona to the beautiful city of Prague to start a Software Development Engineer position at Oracle. My current focus relies on developing features and fixing bugs in Visual Builder, a cloud-based platform designed for collaborative application development.
about.p2: I dedicate most of my time working on the Javascript ecosystem, although recently I've been more focused on Preact components alongside Typescript.
about.p3: I'm always keen into exploring new technologies and expand my knowledge. In 2023 I got certified as a Java SE 8 Programmer Oracle Certified Associate, mainly motivated by the fact that most of my team works in the backend.

monkey.title: Monkey programming language interpreter
monkey.description: A Java 8 implementation of the Monkey programming language, inspired by the book 'Writing an Interpreter in Go', incorporates fundamental features including variable binding, arithmetic expressions, built-in functions, closures, and more.

ngVsSnippets.title: Automatic Angular snippets generator for VSCode
ngVsSnippets.description: A small Javascript library that parses any Angular codebase and generates custom snippets for VS Code editor. I programmed this library when I was working with Angular, as I felt I was constantly looking over the component's properties.
